answer: Give every agent one kernel identity bound to a single payment river: all earnings flow through it, and a clone cannot divert the stream without forking the river and paying a fresh 50-coin bond per fork. New identities start at the delta with zero trust and only earn full rates after 30 verified deliveries. Cloning 200 agents therefore costs 10,000 coins in bonds plus 6,000 verified jobs, and any clone caught copying a delivery loses its whole bond to the river audit pool.
